title: Responsible AI Considerations in Text Summarization Research: A Review of Current Practices

bias_targets.methodology: A systematic literature review and multi-round qualitative annotation of 333 text summarization papers from the ACL Anthology to track how frequently and specifically authors report dataset biases (e.g., noting generic "political bias" or "biased views") in their ethical considerations or limitations sections.

Qualitative coding and annotation of the literature to identify if papers evaluate or report model limitations related to gender, specifically tracking instances where models generate wrong gender pronouns/terms (misgendering) in output summaries.
